items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: You name me one cat -- one trumpet player living today who could what Cat Anderson did... That man turned him out.

ctx.x: He had to change mouthpieces to go that high. Cat ain't change no mouthpiece. It's the same mouthpiece.
He did (singing notes), hit all five of them. The band say, yoom. On the end, he be out there by himself and the band would break off, and Cat would say -- hit them C's (singing notes). Then he
